channel.title: ZDI: Upcoming Advisories
channel.description: The following is a list of vulnerabilities discovered by Zero Day Initiative researchers that are yet to be publicly disclosed. The affected vendor has been contacted on the specified date and while they work on a patch for these vulnerabilities, TrendAI customers are protected from exploitation by IPS filters delivered ahead of public disclosure. Once the affected vendor patches the vulnerability, we publish an accompanying security advisory which describes the issue, including links to the vendor's fixes.
